knowledge_base.title: Synthetic delivery FAQ
knowledge_base.text: For late parcel delivery, check tracking and contact the carrier. Keep your order identifier.

knowledge_base.title: Synthetic battery FAQ
knowledge_base.text: For an unsafe or broken battery, stop using the item and contact support.

research_sources.title: Synthetic delivery observations
research_sources.text: Synthetic study: late parcel delivery often involved stale tracking. Carrier contact helped locate delayed parcels in this fictional sample.

research_sources.title: Synthetic battery observations
